predicate: Registered users shall be able to log in by providing their email and password.

predicate: Upon submitting valid credentials, the system shall authenticate the user and redirect to the product catalog.

predicate: The login form shall validate that the email address contains a valid domain structure with a top-level domain.
source_span: The login form shall validate that the email address contains a valid domain structure with a top-level domain.

predicate: Submissions with invalid email formats such as missing domain extensions shall be rejected with an error message.

predicate: The login form shall enforce a minimum password length of at least 6 characters.

predicate: If a user enters a password shorter than 6 characters, the form shall prevent submission and display a validation error.

predicate: The product catalog page shall provide category filters that allow users to view only products belonging to the selected category.

predicate: Selecting a category shall immediately filter the displayed product list to items in that category.

predicate: The product catalog shall allow filtering items by maximum price.
source_span: The product catalog shall allow filtering items by maximum price.

predicate: Setting a price threshold shall display all products with price less than or equal to the selected maximum price threshold.
source_span: Setting a price threshold shall display all products with price less than or equal to the selected maximum price threshold.

predicate: Products with a inventory stock count of zero shall display an 'Out of stock' badge.

predicate: The add-to-cart button for out of stock products shall be disabled.

predicate: Clicking the add to cart button on an available product shall increment the cart item count and add the selected item to the cart.
source_span: Clicking the add to cart button on an available product shall increment the cart item count and add the selected item to the cart.

predicate: In the shopping cart, each item line total shall accurately reflect the product unit price multiplied by the selected quantity.
source_span: In the shopping cart, each item line total shall accurately reflect the product unit price multiplied by the selected quantity.

predicate: Changing item quantity shall dynamically update the line total.

predicate: Users shall be able to apply promotional coupon codes in the shopping cart.

predicate: Applying a valid coupon code shall deduct the stated discount amount from the cart subtotal rather than increasing the total.

predicate: The cart summary shall include a standard shipping fee for orders.

predicate: In step 1 of the multi-step checkout wizard, the user must provide a non-empty shipping address and city.

predicate: Attempting to proceed to step 2 with an empty shipping address shall be blocked with an explicit validation error.

predicate: The checkout order summary shall calculate the final grand total as subtotal minus discounts plus shipping fee.

predicate: The displayed grand total must include shipping charges whenever shipping fee is applicable.
